overview.description: The Northern Trust Morningstar Developed Markets ex-US Factor Tilt ETF (TLTD) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks an index of equities from developed countries outside the US. The index favors smaller, value-oriented firms. TLTD was launched on Sep 28, 2012 and is issued by Northern Trust.
